Athletics Federation of India
National Inter District Junior Athletics Meet

NIDJAM Record Book

All 19 editions of NIDJAM, 2003 to 2024: every final from the 16 editions with results, full heats for 2015 and 2024, and the meet records set at the other three. Medallists, top-eight finalists and record setters, searchable in one place.

Source: AFI official results files published on indianathletics.in (each row links to its file). Full results for the 2nd (2004), 3rd (2005) and 8th (2010) editions are not online; for those, the page lists the meet records they set, taken from the record lines printed in later AFI results files.
Athletes are linked across years by name, gender and birth year, so a spelling change can split one athlete into two entries. Meet records are shown as AFI flagged them in each results file. Dates of birth and districts are as printed by AFI.
